params.enabled_if: column is NOT CASESPECIFIC on the source (Teradata default in ANSI-off sessions); disable per column where the DDL says CASESPECIFIC and the target column stays UTF8_BINARY

params.places_policy: finest source scale in the estate (DECIMAL(18,8) EXCHANGE_RATE); the harness applies one params set per rule name, so never lower this to a monetary scale -- scale-widening on AVG/derived columns is absorbed by the tolerance record's numeric_abs_tol, not by rounding every decimal
